title: Synthetic Patient Monitoring — A/B/C Comparison
description: Auditable comparison of threshold, batch NEWS2, and streaming NEWS2 paths.

list.name: patient
list.label: Synthetic patient
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "patient_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "alarms" or r._measurement == "patient_vitals")

panels.title: NEWS2 score — Approaches B/C only
panels.description: B/C composite scores on the same time range. Approach A has no NEWS2 score.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alarms" and r._field == "news2_score")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.patient_id =~ /^${patient:regex}$/ and r.scenario_id =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/ and r.scoring_approach =~ /^${approach:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["patient_id", "scenario_id", "scoring_approach"])

panels.title: Alarm timing by approach
panels.description: Aligned event time makes relative A/B/C alarm timing visible; it is not labelled as live pipeline latency.

targets.query:
a = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "patient_vitals" and r._field == "value" and r.scoring_approach == "A")

bc = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alarms" and r._field == "news2_score")

union(tables: [a, bc])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.patient_id =~ /^${patient:regex}$/ and r.scenario_id =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/ and r.scoring_approach =~ /^${approach:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r.alarm_level == "critical" then 2 else if r.alarm_level == "warning" then 1 else 0}))
  |> group(columns: ["patient_id", "scoring_approach"])

panels.title: Alarming observations per minute by approach
panels.description: Count of alarm observations per one-minute window; repeated scores are observations, not distinct clinical episodes.

targets.query:
a = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "patient_vitals" and r._field == "value" and r.scoring_approach == "A" and r.alarm_level != "ok")

bc = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alarms" and r._field == "news2_score" and r.alarm_level != "ok")

union(tables: [a, bc])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.patient_id =~ /^${patient:regex}$/ and r.scenario_id =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/ and r.scoring_approach =~ /^${approach:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["scoring_approach"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: count, createEmpty: true)

panels.title: Telemetry versions
panels.description: Latest schema, pipeline, threshold, and transport labels for each selected path.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alarms" or r._measurement == "patient_vitals")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.patient_id =~ /^${patient:regex}$/ and r.scenario_id =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/ and r.scoring_approach =~ /^${approach:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["patient_id", "scenario_id", "scoring_approach", "schema_version", "pipeline_version", "threshold_version", "transport"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "patient_id", "scenario_id", "scoring_approach", "schema_version", "pipeline_version", "threshold_version", "transport"])
